text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae was set to appear on a variety show as the talked-about local idol.
I accompanied her to the shoot, but—

text_block_list.name: Celebrity MC
text_block_list.text: It was a prank~! Did I scare you, Tarumae-chan?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh, a prank...? 
Umm, excuse me...!

text_block_list.name: Co-starring Idol
text_block_list.text:
Peek-a-boo~! The bear was me all along!
Fufu, Tarumae-chan, your innocent reaction is so adorable~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, I couldn't react at all...
Should I have acted more surprised and fallen over backward?
At the very least, my comments should've been better...!"
choice_data_list: Good work. That was more than good enough.

text_block_list.name: Co-starring Idol
text_block_list.text:
Ah, great work tod—whoops, are you reviewing your performance?
I super love that drive for self-improvement!

text_block_list.name: Co-starring Idol
text_block_list.text: There's tons of prank gigs out there, and undercover everyday ones too... You'll get another chance! Hang in there!
—A few days later. Just as I was about to have dinner with Hokko Tarumae, we ran into Smart Falcon and Eishin Flash.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to just jump in and share a table with you!
There weren't any other open seats~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: No, if anything, I'm honored to join you!!
choice_data_list: Well then, shall we dig in?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes! Down the hatch—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(...Huh? With my ramen, instead of chopsticks,
there's a knife and fork... Could this be—)

text_block_list.name: Co-starring Idol
text_block_list.text: There's tons of prank gigs out there, and undercover everyday ones too... You'll get another chance! Hang in there!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(...Falco-san, a major senior in the industry.
And Trainer-san, who was on set.
If those two were behind this prank...!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Alright... Learning from what happened the other day,
I need to give a proper reaction...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing at all!
I'll dig in too—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wait, whaaat!? A knife and fork!?
How am I supposed to eat ramen with these?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? Chopsticks?
Where are the chopstiiicks~~!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wah, really!?
How could something like this happen~?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(...The fanfare didn't play...!
Does that mean there's still more to come...?)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (I should stay calm and get a drink or—)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: S-So sour...!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Uuuugh...
Ah, hahaha... My mouth feels all puckered up... and tiiiight...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Tarumae-san,
you forgot to put syrup in the drink—
(Heh—)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Even a blackout?! Um,
what reaction would look best on the show—)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? It's pitch black~~!!
Where is everyone~~!?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ouch! Did I bump into something!?
I can't see anything at all~~!!

text_block_list.name: Campus PA
text_block_list.text:
"There was a temporary power outage due to a system error,
but power is now being restored."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Phew.
I'm glad things were restored so quickly.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, a system trouble...?
...Or rather..."
choice_data_list: Tarumae, why are you looking around like that?
Tarumae, why are you looking around like that?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh?! No, well...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer. If you're in on the prank,
you know where the cameras are, right?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Could the reveal not be happening because my reaction wasn't good enough on camera, or...
choice_data_list: Camera...? What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I-I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I totally mistook a simple mishap for a hidden camera prank
and had such a weird reaction... It's so embarrassing, honestly...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry for the trouble!
Uuuuugh~~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Why, why? Falco was super moved!
It totally felt like you were giving it your all as an idol☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Reacting naturally even while knowing it's a prank... That is something far beyond my abilities.
choice_data_list: I'll just consider it good practice for a prank.
Your adaptability was second to none.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah! The bar set for idols on variety shows has been getting higher and higher lately!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Like, with running late pranks, it's all about
how viral of a comment you can drop~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
A fake tardiness prank...!!
Please, by all means, teach me how it's done!

While chatting with her senior, Smart Falcon,
Hokko Tarumae seemed to forget
all about her embarrassment.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The way they responded to an unexpected mishap
with such bright flexibility...
Even I was quite impressed.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Flash-san... Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thank you very much.
I want to polish my adaptability even more!
